conversations.content: 题目要求实现一个带 SQL、精确向量 TopK、事务和崩溃恢复的 MiniVectorDB，并在 Linux 容器中运行。我接下来查看配套题包和测试协议，再按评测要求实现。
已取得官方分支和 20 个公开样例。题包明确要求使用 JSONL 通信，与赛题介绍中的描述有出入，我会以题包协议为准。实现将使用自写磁盘存储和事务逻辑，并补测公开样例未覆盖的强杀恢复、非法向量和内存限制。
实现方案已确定：用写时复制 B+ 树保存主键与磁盘记录位置，提交时切换带校验的元数据。这样无需把全表载入内存，失败语句和未提交事务也能回滚。TopK 会使用有界堆，并先过滤、再计算距离。
第一版已通过官方全部 20 个公开样例，覆盖 95 条 SQL 以及重启、事务和 float32 语义。接下来会补上真正的向量块索引，并测试强杀恢复、失败语句原子性和大数据下的内存占用。
好的，我会把可直接推送的本地分支和材料整理好，附上手动 push 与提测步骤。最后再做一次构建和回归验证。

implementation_records.content: Cloned oceanbase/seekdb branch 2026-competition-round2 at f4d4e26653af823a7601668802f80e374ad6643c and read STDIO_PROTOCOL.md and public case files. Chose the actual JSONL driver protocol over the older prose description of direct SQL stdin.

Implemented C++20 lexer, typed SQL execution, persistent COW primary-key B+ tree, statement rollback by allocation boundary, explicit transaction catalog roots, durable commit via data fsync then alternating checksummed manifest slots. Storage errors fail closed rather than acknowledging uncertain writes.

After the first public pass, added an actual immutable covering vector block index with metric-ball bounds and a COW mutation delta tree. Base entries covered by the delta are skipped; current delta rows are merged. Both exact and ann modes return exact results.

Added external merge sorting for ORDER BY without LIMIT and streamed JSON result rows. Added case-preserving column and alias labels while retaining case-insensitive identifier lookup; regression includes mixed-case identifiers.

experiments.context: Actual final case-preservation regression run; test name prefixes and unittest class qualification shortened in this excerpt. A separate static-binary run is retained in validation/regression.txt.

experiments.interpretation: The on-disk database exceeded the process address-space cap and the restart query still succeeded. This is evidence against an all-records-in-memory design, not a measurement of whole-container memory including file cache.

All 1000 result ID sequences and distances matched a Python math.dist oracle over stored float32 values, including 500 filtered queries. These timings and RSS are local diagnostics, not formal T/B/M, recall measurements on hidden data, or a competition score.

retrospective.content: Public samples alone were insufficient evidence for crash safety and bounded memory. Added forced process termination, recovery interruption, page-cache eviction rollback and larger-than-address-space data tests.

Exact block search was chosen for deterministic recall and simpler transaction maintenance. Metric bounds can be weak in high dimensions; no HNSW speed claim is made. Append-only history avoids in-place corruption of committed data but currently causes disk amplification without compaction.
